products.name: Proactive Remediations at Scale — Detection & Remediation Script Packs for Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Stop fixing the same endpoint problem one ticket at a time — author, deploy, and operate detect-and-remediate script pairs that find and fix issues fleet-wide before users notice.
products.description:
Stop fixing the same endpoint problem one ticket at a time — author, deploy, and operate detect-and-remediate script pairs that find and fix issues fleet-wide before users notice.

The same endpoint problems recur across thousands of devices — a stopped service, a bad registry value, an expired cert, a misconfigured setting — and fixing them reactively, one ticket at a time, never ends. Proactive Remediations (part of Endpoint Analytics) runs a detection script on a schedule and, when it finds the problem, runs a remediation script to fix it — automatically, fleet-wide, with reporting. This solution is the engine: how to author safe detect/remediate PowerShell pairs, deploy and schedule them, scope and pilot them, read the output and pass/fail reporting, and build a governed library of reusable script packs — with the safety discipline (idempotency, -WhatIf-style dry runs, exit-code contracts, rollback) that keeps an auto-remediation from becoming an auto-outage.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • The detect/remediate model — how the pair works, the exit-code contract, run context (system vs user), schedule, and scoping; flagged verify-with-Microsoft for current behavior
  • Author safe pairs — idempotent detection, minimal remediation, dry-run first, logging, and the failure modes that make auto-remediation dangerous
  • Deploy + pilot — assign to a pilot group, read detection/remediation status and output columns, then wave to production with guardrails
  • A governed script-pack library — versioning, naming, review/approval, and reusable packs for common recurring issues
  • Operate + report — success/failure trends, re-detection to prove the fix held, and when to retire a pack

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A working Proactive Remediations practice that finds and fixes recurring endpoint issues fleet-wide before users notice — with the safety discipline to keep automation from causing outages.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PROREM-Detect-Template.ps1 — read-only DETECTION template for an Intune Proactive Remediation
    • PROREM-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory of Proactive Remediation script packages
    • PROREM-Remediate-Template.ps1 — REMEDIATION template that DEFAULTS TO A DRY-RUN (preview)
    • PROREM-Report.ps1 — export the detection/remediation success-fail trend to CSV
    • PROREM-Validate.ps1 — PASS/FAIL that the pilot remediation package is present, assigned, and reporting

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
